title: Why your website visitors never become discovery calls
summary: The AI sequence that turns website visitors into booked consultations — 11 recipients

payload.subject: Why your website visitors never become discovery calls
payload.html:
Hey {{first_name}},


Here's something most business owners never see.


A visitor lands on your website, reads for a minute, then closes the tab.


No call. No form. No trace they were ever there.


That happens dozens of times a week — and it's the most expensive leak most service businesses have.


Here's the thing.


The old way is a contact form that sits in an inbox until someone gets around to it.


By then the visitor's already booked with someone else.


The AI Growth Engine works differently.


It talks to the visitor the moment they land, asks a couple of questions, and offers to put a consultation straight on your calendar before they ever leave the page.


One personal training business we studied had steady website traffic and almost nothing to show for it.


Visitors browsed the program pages, then vanished.


No consultations. No calendar activity. Just a quiet phone and a traffic report that looked fine.


They put an AI-driven sequence on the site — the kind that greets a visitor, asks what they're looking for, and offers to book a consultation on the spot.


Within weeks, the same traffic that used to leave silently was landing on the calendar instead.


Same visitors. Same website.


The only thing that changed was whether anyone asked them to act.


That's the pattern across service businesses running this kind of sequence.


It's not about getting more traffic.


It's about catching the traffic you already have.


Now — this isn't for everyone.


This works best for businesses that book 1:1 consultations or discovery calls.


If your website doesn't lead to any kind of booked conversation, skip this one.


Want me to put together a custom AI + marketing plan for {{business_name}}?


Book a quick discovery call and I'll show you exactly where The AI Growth Engine would plug into your website: Book your call here.


Talk soon,


Dylan | Digigrowth


P.S. — this isn't a sales pitch, just twenty minutes to see if this fits how {{business_name}} actually gets booked.
